multiple_comparison_note: Bonferroni applied with m=45 (all dims). 26 dims are degenerate (zero variance in both samples, KS has no power). Effective independent tests ~= 19. Using m=19 would give alpha_prime=0.00263; this does not change the conclusion. We keep m=45 because infrastructure validation prioritizes avoiding false positives.
